offering_description.value: Operates casual dining steakhouse restaurants that serve steaks, ribs, chicken and seafood to families and groups, and franchises the concept to independent operators. It prepares food in its own kitchens for dine-in, take-out and catering orders.

primary_services.value: dine-in restaurant service; catering; take-out orders

customer_segment.value: B2C: families, groups and individuals dining in restaurants, plus catering and gift card buyers

end_markets.value: casual dining; food service; consumer dining

revenue_model.value: product sales: food and beverages sold in company-owned restaurants; licensing or royalties: franchise fees and royalties paid by franchised restaurant operators

value_chain_position.value: service provider: prepares and serves meals in restaurants, sold to diners and event hosts; brand owner: owns the restaurant concept and licenses it to franchisees, who pay royalties

geography_served.value: global: company-owned restaurants across the United States, plus franchised restaurants in several other countries

specialization.value: niche specialist: one casual dining steakhouse concept

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned restaurants serving dine-in and take-out guests; online: online ordering and third-party delivery for take-out; other: franchised restaurants operated by independent franchisees

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety rules and state liquor licensing for alcohol sales, plus labor and health rules
